title: CARVED WOODEN PUTI - AS IS L-4...
reason: Well carved fruitwood putto sold as is; good face and hair, possibly older Continental; crack and repairs limit value.
findings: Carved fruitwood putto in a flying pose holding a wooden ring; better carving than the bare title suggests (smiling expressive face, crisp curled hair, good hands and feet). No signature, maker's mark, label or inscription on any of the 3 photos. Glossy shellac or varnish finish. A round wooden plug fills an old fixing hole in the back, with two small dark pin holes beside it, so it was probably once mounted on something (wall, bed canopy or furniture). The ring is a separate turned ring with bound leather or rawhide patches at the joins, which looks like an old repair. Baroque-style Continental carving (Italian or Alpine type); age cannot be proven from the photos.
condition: Sold as is. Hairline crack along the shoulder and upper arm joint of the free arm (photos 2 and 3), the arm may be a glued separate piece; round plug repair and two pin holes in the back; ring has bound repairs; glossy finish scuffed and uneven in places. Figure otherwise complete, hands and feet intact.
rescore_note: Well carved fruitwood putto (good face, hair, hands), but the glossy modern-looking finish and lack of any mark leave age unproven; cracked glued arm, back plug and pin holes, repaired ring and sold as is, so the $80-200 band. Estimate only, no live comps.
